values.body: Launch of the mobile app is confirmed for 3 March. Marketing needs the final screenshots by 20 February.
I'll deliver the screenshots on 18 February. Do we still plan the webinar on launch day?
Yes, webinar at 4 pm CET on 3 March, Lukas hosts it.
Fine by me. I need the demo account ready a week before.
I'll set up the demo account by 24 February.
Customer Brightline disputes invoice INV-2026-0412: they were charged for 12 seats but use 9.
Contract says 10 seats minimum, so 9 is not possible. We should credit 2 seats.
Agreed. I'll issue a credit note for 2 seats, €180 in total.
Please also update their subscription to 10 seats from next month.
API latency spiked to 4 s at 09:40, the EU database is at 95% CPU.
I see a runaway report query from the analytics job. Killing it now.
Query killed at 09:52, latency back to 200 ms.
Thanks. Let's add a timeout of 60 s to analytics queries. I'll write the post-mortem by Friday.
Hi Dana, do you have 10 minutes for the Northwind call at 15:00 today?
We have 3 finalists for the backend role: Chen, Okafor and Silva.
Okafor's system design interview was the strongest.
Silva withdrew this morning, so it's Chen or Okafor.
Let's make an offer to Okafor. Budget is up to 85k.
I'll prepare the offer and send it on Monday.
@Dana can you join the offer call with Okafor on Monday at 11?
The move to the new Paris office is planned for 14 April.
Movers need the final seating plan by 1 April.
I'll share the seating plan next week. Everyone gets a locker; badges arrive on 10 April.
Parking will be limited to 8 spaces, first come first served.
Q3 forecast is at €1.2M against a €1.4M target.
Two big deals slipped to Q4: Northwind (€150k) and Contoso (€90k).
We need a recovery plan. Sam, please list deals that can be pulled into Q3.
I'll send the list by Wednesday.
Fabrikam told us they will not renew in June: they find the reporting too limited.
The new report builder ships in May. Could we show them a preview?
Good idea. I'll book a preview session with their ops lead next week.
I'll prepare a demo with their own data.
From 1 January the Pro plan goes from €29 to €35 per user per month.
Existing customers keep €29 until their next renewal.
We need to notify customers 60 days ahead, so by 2 November.
Correct. Amira, please prepare the notification email.
Acme's kickoff is on 5 May. 40 users to onboard in two waves.
Wave 1 is sales (25 users), wave 2 is support (15 users) two weeks later.
Data import from their old CRM needs a CSV export by 28 April.
I asked their IT contact; they confirmed the export date.
@Dana will you run the admin training for wave 1?
The ISO 27001 surveillance audit is on 12 June.
Three findings from last year are still open, the access review is the biggest one.
Access review must be finished by 31 May. Amira, can you own it?
Yes, I'll run it with team leads in two sessions.
Dana, the Okafor offer letter needs your signature by tomorrow noon.
Our screen supplier delays delivery of 500 units by three weeks.
That affects the Lyon store opening on 2 June.
An alternative supplier can deliver 200 units by 20 May at 8% higher cost.
Order the 200 units from them; the rest can arrive later.
Globex renewal is due 30 September, contract value €210k.
They asked for a 3-year term in exchange for a 12% discount.
Finance allows max 8% for 3 years.
I'll counter with 8% and add free premium support for year one.
Bug #4821: PDF export fails for invoices with more than 100 lines.
Root cause is a page-break loop in the renderer. Fix is in review.
Can we ship it in the 2.14 patch on Thursday?
Yes, if QA signs off by Wednesday evening.
Reminder: the office is closed from 24 December to 1 January.
Support needs one person on call each day.
Lukas covers 27-29 December, Amira 30-31 December.
Who takes 24-26?
@Dana could you take 24-26 December?
Excel advanced training on 9 October, 14:00-17:00, room Atlas.
12 seats left. Sign up in the HR portal by 2 October.
The trainer asked everyone to bring a laptop with Excel 365.
Stock count found 37 missing units of SKU TX-200.
Probably mis-scanned returns from last week. I'll check the return logs.
Found them: 35 units were booked to the wrong location. 2 are really missing.
Thanks. I'll correct the locations and write off the 2 units.
The new website goes live on 15 September.
The pricing page still shows the old plans.
Right, I'll update it with the new Pro price before launch.
Also the German translation is missing for the blog.
Translation agency delivers on 10 September.
Partner Zenith wants a Shopify integration by Q1.
We have a connector beta; 3 customers use it.
Zenith would resell it to 50 merchants if it's GA.
GA needs webhook retries and better logging, around 6 weeks of work.
Can you send me the Q3 slides before the board call?
Sales kickoff 2027 is in Lisbon, 20-22 January.
Hotel block booked for 60 people at the Tivoli.
Agenda draft is in the shared folder, please comment by Friday.
Flights must be booked through the travel portal before 15 December.
@Dana will you present the partner track?
Support backlog is at 312 tickets, the oldest is 9 days.
Mostly password resets after the SSO change.
